question: Can the same final-MLP adapter learn the 20 paired token choices under direct supervision at all 40 decision positions?
ordering: fixed ascending original dataset row index; every mapped position in every update
supervision: Equal ordinary full-vocabulary CE only at each mapped first-divergent non-EOS target. Other 2319 target positions contribute no training loss.
checkpoint_selection: Maximize complete decision pairs, then total correct decision targets, then earlier eligible update; select before generation.
snapshot_note: The existing interval of 25 updates additionally saves update 75. It is retained as a diagnostic artifact; eligible selection points match the earlier proposal.
measurement: Token choice at the recorded prefix, complete generated JSON decision, citation validity and explanation meaning are scored separately.
scope: Direct decision-subtask control; full teacher-forced readouts for all 64 rows are also recorded.
